instructions.question: What sentiment does this Albanian Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Negative needs a strong negative reaction: horror or despair words, insults or curses, claims the numbers are fake or manipulated, or blame and mockery aimed at the institute, admin or government, even as a joke. Neutral covers calm or reasoned comments: questions, data requests, calculations, arguments that testing misses cases, scolding citizens without insults, jokes about towns, friends or posting delays. Positive needs explicit praise, thanks, blessings, good news about recoveries, or hopeful encouragement. Town pride, sports talk, off-topic congratulations and predictions are neutral.

neutral.what: Calm, playful or reasoned comments: questions, data requests, calculations, speculation about undercounting, advice, criticism of citizens without insults, teasing friends about their town, jokes about delays, tags, condolences.
examples: Pse ka Mitrovica Verit nuk po jepni Rezultate hiq !? (Why aren't you giving any results for North Mitrovica!?)
Hala se ka pi kafen kryesori.. (The boss hasn't had his coffee yet..)
Sa keq, numri kaq i larte (How bad, the number is so high)
neutral.cues: hahaha, tagged names, pse (why), a ka (is there), duhet (should), hajde ma gjall (come on, livelier), kampion (champion), ngushllime (condolences)
neutral.not_for: Jokes implying the institute inflates or botches the numbers, and insults, are negative.

positive.what: Praise, thanks, blessings, recovery wishes, pleasure at recoveries or falling cases, hopeful encouraging appeals.
examples: Asllan A Haxholli A ka lajm mat mir, 35 t'sherum (Is there better news, 35 recovered)
Mashallah kofshin me ymer (God bless, may they live long)
positive.cues: bravo, ju lumtë (well done), faleminderit (thank you), lajm i mirë (good news), t'sherum (recovered), shendet (health), do e kalojm (we'll get through it), mashallah
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise is negative. 'Prishtina kampion' (Prishtina champion), 'Urime libralizimi i vizav' (congratulations on visa liberalisation) and 'Edhe pak e iku edhe ky virus!' (a little more and this virus is gone too) are neutral.

negative.what: Horror, despair, insults, curses, distrust of the numbers, anger at measures, and blame or mockery aimed at the institute, admin or government.
examples: 15 te vdekur, tmerr. (15 dead, horror.)
kurr ska mu ba mir me ket popull budall (It'll never get better with this stupid people)
Admin rakin e dopt e paske pas sot (Admin, you must have had the strong raki today)
Gati e keni nr me qu në 1600 te infektuar aq sa ju vyn (You've almost got the number up to 1600 infected, as much as suits you)
negative.cues: tmerr (horror), mjerim (misery), kjamete (catastrophe), budall (stupid), qija nanen (curse), rrene (lies), fshehni (hide), nale doren (stop your hand), ndreqne gabimin (fix the mistake), na murren nqaf (you're killing us), e hupi kontrollen (lost control)
negative.not_for: Reasoned arguments about testing or citizens' behaviour without insults are neutral.
